Fugen (新型転換炉ふげん), JAEA Advanced Thermal Reactor prototype, Tsuruga. Permanently shut down 2003-03-29, now in 廃止措置(decommissioning, completion deferred to ~FY2040) -> current operable = 0 MW. Former gross electrical output: 16.5万kW; 16.5 x 10 = 165 MW former. OSM's 35.7 is wrong (does not match the 165 MW former rating).

Current operable capacity = unit 2 only = 116万kW; 116×10 = 1160 MW. Unit 1 (35.7万kW BWR) decommissioned: 営業運転終了 2015-04, 廃止措置着手 2017-05, excluded. Unit 2 idle (manual shutdown 2011-05); NRA rejected restart 2024 but reactor exists & not decommissioned, so its installed capacity reported.
1号機50万kW+2号機70万kW=120万kW=1200MW（万kW×10）。両機運転中。OSM値1200MWと一致。事業者は北陸電力。地域は本来hokuriku（福井県敦賀市）だがバッチではchubu。
140万kW×10=1400MW(2018年現在値:3号機70万+4号機70万kW)。JERA(愛知県田原市)。2026-03-31全設備廃止完了。
